parameters.query:
INSERT IGNORE INTO kvm4_db.rf_nota
  (rf, nIdNf, cNumNFSe, cNumOs, emp, status_nota, status_em, origem)
SELECT o.rf, n.nIdNf, n.cNumNFSe, n.cNumOs, n.emp, NULL, NULL, 'ESTEIRA'
FROM kvm4_db.rf_os o
JOIN kvm4_db.NF n ON n.cNumOs = o.cNumOs
WHERE o.promovido_em IS NULL

UPDATE kvm4_db.rf_os o
JOIN kvm4_db.NF n ON n.cNumOs = o.cNumOs
SET o.promovido_em = NOW()
WHERE o.promovido_em IS NULL

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kvm4_db.rf_os) AS rf_os_total,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kvm4_db.rf_os WHERE promovido_em IS NULL) AS ainda_sem_nota,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kvm4_db.rf_os WHERE promovido_em IS NOT NULL) AS promovidos,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kvm4_db.rf_nota WHERE origem='ESTEIRA') AS vinculos_da_esteira,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kvm4_db.rf_nota) AS rf_nota_total,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kvm4_db.rf_os o WHERE o.promovido_em IS NULL
     AND o.criado_em < NOW() - INTERVAL 3 DAY) AS pendentes_ha_mais_de_3_dias
